review_description: They did everything were friendly offered advice on all my questions
Nothing was too much trouble for Scott at Greenbank Solar.  The installation was A1, top class. Would highly recommend them.  Customer service needs a 10 star rating..

Good sales and a lot of knowledge about the solar products.  Punctual and friendly install team.  Product has done amazing things for my power bill.Small scuff on the paint with the internal installation of the inverters but not an issue as the repairs were organised instantly and without fuss.  Would recommend.

Coming from a technical background myself, I was very impressed in the way Scott from Greenbank Solar was answering my questions.I was also happy with his return response. It was informative and timely.His team is polite, efficient and punctual.There was a slight hiccup with a faulty meter, but Scott was on it immediately. A replacement was soon installed and the system was A1 functional.I recommend Scott's team to satisfy your Solar Generation requirements here in Brisbane.

Brilliant from start to finish, thanks to Scott's impeccable customer service;  a visit to check everything over the day before, then the installation team did their amazing best, and the whole system was up and running perfectly in FOUR HOURS!  Honestly, this was a dream tradesman/specialists experience from start to finish, and I couldn't be happier.  Punctual, friendly, skilled at their work and I cannot recommend them highly enough.  :)  Thanks Scott, Jake, Karl and Matthew!

Really happy with the whole process. We had plenty of questions, which Scott was more than happy to answer. The installers were great, easy to work with and very professional.The system is double our previous systems capacity, with better quality components and potential production all day rather than just from midday. Looking forward to a lot smaller power bills.The new system analytics has identified a feed in over voltage surge issue, which is currently effecting our production during the peak production periods each day. With Scott's assistance, we have been able to provide evidence and data to Energex, who are currently monitoring.

Scott was fabulous to deal with. He patiently explained the differences between panel & inverter brands, potential energy production of different combinations etc.  He never got frustrated with my endless questions. He provided 2 detailed quotes & was happy to do a site visit. From initial contact to installation took just under two weeks.The installation team were also great to deal with. They arrived on time and were polite & professional. They confirmed system components, panel arrays & inverter location prior to commencing.There were a couple of teething problems after installation but Scott & the team were very responsive, sorting the issues quickly & with no fuss.I feel very confident in recommending Greenbank Solar to anyone in the SE QLD area.

Quoting was extremely informative considering that it was over the Christmas and new year period.Took longer than expected due to the extreme weather and having to install a new fuse box and upgrade of hot water system. Did not impact on our daily routine, only when power was off and that was not for too long. Took most of their rubbish away with them. Very punctual .We also paid for bird netting around panels which I have not included in the price paid. Also have not included price to upgrade hot water system. Had to tick quality of system even though we have not used it yet. They did organise grid connection but still waiting for Energex. Payment was split up into deposit part payment on ordering panels and full payment upon installation.

13.2kW Solar system installed by Greenbank Solar!Excellent service & quality workmanship, professionally installed by a top level team, to comply with all the relevant standards!Scott has been so helpful with the best advice & and an excellent competitive price!! From initial quoting and organising financing, to commissioning and connection with Energex, as well as energy provider advice, he takes care of everything and answered all my questions honestly & informatively.We couldnâ€™t recommend anyone else more professional & competent at supplying a solar solution!If youâ€™re thinking solar, donâ€™t take the first & cheapest quote... contact Scott Leaver!
Wealth of information and happy to educate about system and answer any questions we had.Punctual and tidy install.
Process from start to finish was a dream. Scott was informative, accurate and open in everything, install was on time and what I paid for. Would 100% recommend.

Scott was great to deal with during the quote and even assisted with accessing finance.Installation was organised within a couple of weeks of finance approval and the installation team were flexible.End product looks great and performs as well as I could ever have hoped for.After 6 months of use my 15kw system is paying for itself and halved my electricity. After the 4 year finance this system will be making us money and has already ensured we are carbon neutral plus supplying many of our neighbours and their non-solar houses.
Used only quality products, not cheap Chinese panels. Nothing was a problem and was installed quickly.

Sales/quoting process was straightforward and informative.  All of our questions were answered simply and understandable.The installation was very neat, panels were all aligned, no rubbish left lying around, installer arrived on time and was very pleasant and communicative.  He took pride in his workmanship.Once we committed to buying the system, everything was taken care of for us including the connection to the grid.
Scott was thorough in his explanation of the benefits and workings of the solar systems and supplied a quality product promptly and at value for money.
